description: Remove from Blocklist - Remove ONE email or domain from the blocklist (no lists or bulk input). Only entries added by hand (add_to_blocklist or the app's CSV upload) can be removed; entries from unsubscribes, bounces, API syncs or older entries cannot. The removed address can be emailed again, so this needs the user's approval: the client asks the user directly, or the tool returns a preview and a login link where the user removes it in the SalesBlink app.

email.description: The single email address or domain to remove

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: remove_from_blocklist

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Remove From Blocklist
